The tests passed! I can now submit the changes.
The issue was that the loops for the bottom row and left column were not correctly guarded by conditions that checked if there were actually elements to iterate over in those directions. This led to elements being re-added in cases of single-row or single-column matrices, or when the spiral converged to a single row or column. I fixed this by adding `if top < bottom:` before the bottom row loop and `if left < right:` before the left column loop. I also corrected a syntax error introduced in a previous attempt by ensuring the `if` statements were followed by indented blocks.
